item.title: FAA Tells the Times: SpaceX Has Not Applied to Launch Starship From Louisiana
item.description: The federal agency that must approve any launch from Pecan Island says it has no SpaceX application to review yet. Next week’s Starship hearings are about the Texas site only, the FAA said.

item.title: Trump Says the U.S. Doesn’t Need a Deal With Iran: ‘We’ve Got Their Strait.’ Oil Ticks Up as Gulf Coast Gas Prices Fall
item.description: The president’s post on Thursday pushed crude higher for a while after weeks of hopes for a settlement. At the pump, Gulf Coast regular gasoline averaged $3.48 a gallon this week, down 15 cents, but still 88 cents above a year ago.

item.title: Musk: ‘Starbase, Louisiana Will Unlock That Future’
item.description: In a statement the state posted on its SpaceX project page, Elon Musk calls the planned Vermilion Parish spaceport something that “has only existed in science fiction.” Here is his full statement and what the state says will be built.

item.title: State’s Secret SpaceX Plan Listed ‘a New City in Vermilion Parish,’ Records Show
item.description: A March briefing by Louisiana Economic Development, code-named Project Osprey, named a new city among the things needed to win SpaceX. A month later the line was gone. The Times has asked the state what it meant and whether residents would get a say.

item.title: New SpaceX Job Says Starship Will Be Built in Louisiana, With Staff Moving Here in Early 2027
item.description: A director’s listing describes Starship production at the Pecan Island site and says the hire relocates to Louisiana early next year. A second new posting, for a lawyer to win power approvals for SpaceX data centers, is also listed at Pecan Island. That makes 10 openings.

item.title: Abbey Players Open ‘Joseph and the Amazing Technicolor Dreamcoat’ Friday in Downtown Abbeville
item.description: Abbeville’s community theater stages the family musical over two weekends, Nov. 13-22, at its State Street theater. Tickets are $20. Here are the showtimes, the cast and how to get tickets.

item.title: SpaceX Will Try to Catch Both Halves of Starship on Friday, the Rocket It Plans to Fly From Pecan Island
item.description: Starship Flight 15 could launch from Texas as soon as Friday at 4:45 p.m. Central. SpaceX says it would be the first time the booster and the ship both come back to the tower, the kind of reuse a high-rate site like Starbase Louisiana depends on.

item.title: Buc-ee’s Breaks Ground in Lafayette, Its Closest Store to Vermilion Parish, With a February 2028 Target
item.description: The $82 million travel center at I-10 and Louisiana Avenue will have 120 gas pumps, about 700 parking spaces and boudin on the menu. Lafayette’s economic development agency says it will support more than 300 jobs.

item.title: SpaceX Wants Up to 456 Starship Launches a Year From Texas, With Landings in the Gulf. The FAA’s Hearings Are Now Online, and Anyone Can Join
item.description: The FAA moved all five public meetings on SpaceX’s Texas expansion online and gave the public until Dec. 7 to comment. Boosters and ships could come down in the Gulf of America under the plan. Pecan Island is not part of this review.

item.title: Five Vermilion Parish Teams Make the Football Playoffs; Kaplan Earns a First-Round Bye
item.description: Kaplan is the No. 4 seed in Division III Non-Select and won’t play until the regional round. Erath, North Vermilion, Delcambre and Vermilion Catholic all open on the road this week, according to the LHSAA’s official brackets.

item.title: Texas Turned Blue. Here’s What It Could Mean for Starbase Louisiana
item.description: Democrats won the Texas governor’s race and a U.S. Senate seat after Elon Musk spent heavily against them, and the governor-elect has already asked the state to hold off on a land deal near SpaceX’s Texas launch site. Some industry watchers say that could push SpaceX’s future toward Pecan Island.

item.title: Justice Department Awards East Baton Rouge Parish $63.5 Million to Fight Violent Crime
item.description: Baton Rouge is one of four places picked for the Trump administration’s new Model Cities Initiative, a nearly $300 million federal crime effort. The three-year grant will pay for officers, prosecutors, technology and crime labs.

item.title: Coeyn Wise, 20, Wins School Board District C Seat, Becoming the Board’s Youngest Member
item.description: The 2025 Kaplan High graduate beat Harry “Gregg” Meaux 902 to 688 on Election Day. He says his years as a student in the parish’s schools are the best experience he brings.

item.title: Gueydan Sets Dec. 1 Budget Hearing as Town Moves $195,000 From Utilities to Cover Payroll and Bills
item.description: Town records also show Gueydan is asking the state again for money to build a new police and fire station, and a state water project ruled ineligible. Both men in the Dec. 12 mayor’s runoff sit on the board that voted on these items.

item.title: SpaceX Posts Two Environmental Permit Jobs for Starbase Louisiana: Wetlands and Air Pollution
item.description: The new openings show what the company needs before it can build at Pecan Island, Army Corps wetland permits, Louisiana coastal-zone approvals and state air permits, including for on-site power generation. That brings SpaceX’s Pecan Island listings to nine.

item.title: FAA Proposes Easing the Launch Safety Rules Starbase Louisiana Would Fly Under; Public Comment Opens Monday
item.description: Three proposals on file with the Federal Register would change when a rocket must be stopped in flight and how falling debris is judged. The agency also says it wants power to waive some environmental rules and is asking where new spaceports should go.

item.title: Abbeville Meridional and Kaplan Herald Sold to Kentucky-Based Paxton Media Group
item.description: The parish’s two longtime weeklies are among 14 Acadiana-area papers, plus a printing plant in Eunice, that Louisiana State Newspapers has sold to the family-owned chain from Paducah. The price was not disclosed.

item.title: Sheriff: Scammers Are Calling Families of People in the Parish Jail, Asking for Money to ‘Release’ Them
item.description: The callers know the inmate’s name and charge from public arrest records. The Sheriff’s Office says never send money before calling the jail yourself. Separately, deputies are looking for a man seen on video taking batteries and a weed eater from a business on LA 167.

item.title: Giant Omelette Weekend: Abbeville’s Celebration Runs Saturday and Sunday, With the Skillet Lit Sunday Afternoon
item.description: The Confrérie d’Abbeville’s festival fills downtown Nov. 7-8 with music, crafts, an antique car show and a tractor egg-cracking contest. The omelette itself is cooked only on Sunday, starting around 1:30 p.m.

item.title: Abbeville Woman, 69, Killed When Car Overturns on LA 86 Near New Iberia
item.description: She was a passenger and was thrown from the car early Tuesday, State Police said. She is the second Abbeville woman killed in a crash in four days, and troopers say neither was wearing a seat belt.

item.title: Vermilion Parish Election Results: Landry Wins DA Race, Broussard Wins Erath Mayor, Gueydan Heads to Runoff
item.description: Unofficial final returns: Don Landry is the 15th Judicial District’s next district attorney, Stephanie Broussard will lead Erath, and Gueydan picks its mayor in a Dec. 12 runoff. Both parish tax renewals passed.

item.title: Abbeville Woman, 28, Killed in Halloween Crash Near Duson; Rayne Driver Booked on Vehicular Homicide
item.description: State Police say a Buick failed to slow on LA 343 and hit the back of her car as she stopped for a stop sign. The other driver’s breath test came back over the legal limit, troopers said.

item.title: SpaceX Posts a Ninth Starbase Louisiana Job: A Second Communications Lead for Pecan Island
item.description: The new opening, posted Monday on SpaceX’s job board, is a second community-outreach role for the site. Like the first, it must work at Pecan Island full time.

item.title: Vote Early in the Day Tuesday: Storms Likely to Build by Afternoon and Evening in Vermilion Parish
item.description: The National Weather Service gives Abbeville a 50% chance of rain Tuesday, rising to 60% Tuesday night, with gusts up to 25 mph. Polls are open 6 a.m. to 8 p.m.

item.title: Nine Killed as Business Jet From Austin Crashes Into Palm Beach County Neighborhood
item.description: Updated Monday: The NTSB says there is evidence the Learjet began breaking up before it hit the ground, minutes after the crew reported ice and turbulence at 35,000 feet.

item.title: Vermilion Parish Early Vote Already Tops 2022 Midterm: 4,658 Ballots Cast Before Tuesday
item.description: State records show early in-person voting up about 20% over the last midterm. Polls open at 6 a.m. Tuesday and close at 8 p.m.; bring a photo ID.

item.title: Police Jury Approves RV Ordinance, Raises Ordinance Fines to $1,500 and Seeks a Vermilion Levee District
item.description: Draft minutes of the Oct. 21 meeting, posted on the parish website, show every vote was unanimous. A Gueydan drainage tax renewal is also headed to voters in April.

item.title: Old Paint, Oil and Batteries: Parish Sets Household Hazardous Waste Day for Dec. 12
item.description: Vermilion Parish residents can drop off chemicals, tires and recyclables for free at the parish solid waste plant, 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. Bring proof you live in the parish.

item.title: Council on Aging to Ask Police Jury for SpaceX-Related Money; Jurors Set Closed-Door Talk on Starbase Lawsuit
item.description: The Vermilion Parish Police Jury’s committees meet Wednesday, the day after the election. Here is everything on the agendas, taken from the parish’s own posted documents, and how to speak at the meeting.

item.title: School Board Orders Appraisal of 4,000 Acres Next to Starbase Louisiana Ahead of SpaceX Talks
item.description: The land near White Lake brings Vermilion Parish schools $20,000 to $30,000 a year in hunting leases. Superintendent Tommy Byler hopes a deal with SpaceX could mean better pay for teachers.
